addon.notes:
# New

### General
* Added a proper progress UI for several missing actions in Library Mode.
* //find & //findall now combine the same item held in the same bag into a single line with a total count.
* Added a global toggle setting in Lot List that can be used to temporarily turn auto-lotting on/off for all characters.
* Added toggling auto-lot on/off per character in Lot List.

### Use Amount...
* New "Use Amount窶ｦ" option on usable items, alongside Use One and Use All: pick a number of times with a slider.
* //ax use <item> [count|all] allows you to use the same feature from ingame.

### Distribute To...
* Distribute a single stack across several characters. Useful for situations distributing Geas Fete pop items, Einherjar lamps, etc. across your party.

### Drop Everywhere
* New "Drop Everywhere" action drops every copy of an item from every connected character's inventory.
* //ax dropall <item> added as the ingame equivalent.

### Storage NPCs
Added the following storage NPCs, each accepting the listed items:
* Waypoint and Proto-Waypoints: All Crystal/Clusters
* Gobbie Mystery Box NPCs: Habitox, Mystrix, Bountibox, Specilox, Arbitrix, Funtrox, Sweepstox, Priztrix, Wondrix, Rewardox, Winrix: All Coffer Keys
* Anomaly Expert (Eastern Adoulin): All Yggrete Rocks

# Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug where //find & //findall would show multiple items with multiple characters on the same account.
* Fixed a bug where Consolidate and Consolidate By Preference only sent a single stack of items per run.
* Fixed a bug where Curio & Organize when run together would create an infinite supply loop.
* Fixed various dropdown and search menus being cut off or hidden behind other panels across the app.
